After nearly 20 years of gameplay, the NFL has been growing American Football around the world with regular season games played in international cities, such as London , Rio , Mexico City, Melbourne, Berlin, Dublin and others.

For the week seven matchup, two prime NFL teams, the Steelers and Saints, play against each other for domination on the field. Meanwhile, there might be one or two celebrity sightings during the game too.

When Does the NFL Paris Game 2026 Start ?

The NFL Paris Game happens on Sunday (Oct. 25) with a matchup featuring the Pittsburgh Steelers (4-2) taking on the New Orleans Saints (2-4) at Stade de France in Saint-Denis, France, with a start time of 9:30 a.m. ET/6:30 a.m. PT (3:30 p.m. CEST).

What TV Network Features the NFL Paris Game 2026?

The Steelers-Saints game broadcasts on NFL Network, while the NFL game is available to livestream on ESPN Unlimited .

Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances During the NFL Paris Game 2026?

NFL games are known for celebrity sightings, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance. Artists have been known to appear at games in the past, include French NFL fans Kylian Mbappé, Antoine Dupont, DJ Snake, Omar Sy and others.

Nigerian Afro-fusion singer-songwriter and Grammy Award-winner Burna Boy , who captured a hit on the Billboard Hot 100 with “Dai Dai” (FIFA World Cup Official Song 2026) with Shakira this past summer, performs at halftime.

Plus, French pop and R&B singer-songwriter Yseult is also scheduled to perform. The halftime show starts around 11 a.m. ET/8 a.m. PT (5 p.m. CEST).
